question: where do entity x inflows come from. exchange hot wallets would look like withdrawals, fresh unlabeled clusters would fit a consolidation story, coinbase would be mining directly.
method: inputs per inflow transaction, self-inputs removed, net inflow attributed to senders pro rata, senders aggregated across all inflows, top senders profiled by balance and transaction count, one hop traced backwards
caveat: an inflow from an exchange wallet is a withdrawal, not a proven buy. a fresh unlabeled sender is consistent with consolidation, not proof of it. the chain shows the path, never the owner and never the motive.
